neighbours.label: the verb or comma right after a subject naming a future or next item ('Future seminars will', 'the next start is', 'In my next post,')
fire: Thanks for reading this part of the series. In my next post, I will explain how the engine works.
Registration is now closed for spring. Future workshops will focus on writing grant proposals.
The first round went badly for the team. The next match is on Saturday against the league leaders.
We covered the basics today. Upcoming lessons will introduce verbs in the past tense.
The pilot study ended in May. The second phase will recruit about four hundred patients.
Today's tour covered the old town. Tomorrow's walk will take us along the river to the castle.
The fourth edition of the festival, in 2027, will move to a larger site outside the city.
Our company opened two stores this year. The next store will open in Leeds next spring.
quiet: Thanks for reading this part of the series. In this post, I explained how the engine works.

notes: Card top examples: 'Future seminars will', 'the next start is clean', 'In my next post,', 'The third IPY, in'. Output promotes ' shall', ' will', ' agreed'.
